name: Twilight Fangs
source:
Vampires and humans have coexisted for many, many generations now. United in their fight against the werewolf menace, an uneasy alliance has been formed between the two races. Times seem peaceful now and as a college student, things seemed to be going smoothly. However, one day on the way home, you and your vampire friend Rayleigh come across a mysterious man named Vice who’s been injured. You try to help him, but he disappears before you can call an ambulance.

Later, he shows up at your house and you decide to help him only to discover that he’s half vampire and half werewolf! How could such a thing be possible?! To make matters more complicated, the werewolves have sent an investigator to capture him! Soon you find yourself caught up in the war between two races and find out that the peace you were used to was not what it seemed to be… But these dire times might just lead you to discover bonds that will last a lifetime. Will you be able to bridge the gap between two warring races?
translation:
吸血鬼与人类已经共存了许多代。为了共同对抗狼人的威胁，两族结成了一个并不稳固的同盟。如今，时代似乎一片太平，你身为大学生，生活也顺风顺水。然而，某天回家途中，你与吸血鬼朋友雷利遇见了一位受伤的神秘男子，名叫Vice。你们试图帮助他，可还没来得及叫救护车，他便消失了。

后来，他出现在你家。你决定帮助他，却发现他竟是吸血鬼与狼人的混血！这种事怎么可能？！更麻烦的是，狼人还派来一位调查员，要将他抓走！很快，你便卷入两族之间的战争，也发现自己早已习惯的和平，远非表面看来那样……不过，这段危机四伏的日子，也许会让你找到足以维系一生的羁绊。你能弥合这两个交战种族之间的鸿沟吗？
